content: ASCII-only slugify ([a-z0-9-] or \w) silently drops CJK and can yield empty slugs. encodeURIComponent is encoding not slugify. Pinyin transliteration is lossy (homophones, polyphones) and wrongly maps Japanese kanji via Mandarin tables. For EN+ZH: keep Unicode CJK in slug keep-set, collapse whitespace to hyphens, do not require pinyin for v1. Test 你好世界, empty after strip, fullwidth punctuation.
